source_definition_paraphrase: From a recent high move the reference about 25%, operationalized in the book as two-and-a-half 10% limit moves (~27%), and read the current mass below it.
exact_data_required: recent high; current full distribution; corporate actions
frozen_operationalization: 60-session recent high, 25% and 27% shifts; applicable only after >=25% markup and near the high

source_definition_paraphrase: After at least about two months inside an approximately 10% box, mass below the box floor is interpreted as inventory surviving the consolidation.
frozen_operationalization: 40 sessions, <=10% box, cumulative turnover >=100%; report mass below floor

source_definition_paraphrase: Profit ratio above 90% while turnover is below 3% is a high-control proxy; the source warns that relative price position matters.
exact_data_required: same-date full distribution and authoritative turnover

source_definition_paraphrase: CYQKLEN above 18 means over 18% of trapped chips became profitable across the day's OHLC; combined with turnover below 3% and low position.
exact_data_required: authoritative full distribution immediately before every daily OHLC
frozen_operationalization: No proxy substituted: checkpoint distributions are monthly, so exact daily CYQKLEN cannot be formed without prohibited replay.

source_definition_paraphrase: Price crosses a pre-existing dense trapped-cost region with under 3% turnover; released holders did not create expected selling pressure.
exact_data_required: pre-existing full distribution/modes; daily crossing path; turnover
frozen_operationalization: Static prior checkpoint distribution and first band crossing; large released mass >=18%

source_definition_paraphrase: Price rises or leaves a low region while a substantial low-cost chip body remains at low cost rather than following price upward.
exact_data_required: full distribution history; price position; holding age
frozen_operationalization: aged profitable mass, low position, and checkpoint-to-checkpoint retention

source_definition_paraphrase: A concentrated chip structure forms after a materially lower price region and remains at low relative position.
exact_data_required: full distribution density; trailing price position
frozen_operationalization: discovery-frozen HHI 75th percentile and price position <=40%

source_definition_paraphrase: Concentration formed at high relative price after appreciation is a possible distribution rather than accumulation state.
exact_data_required: full distribution density; price position; prior return
frozen_operationalization: same density threshold at price position >=70%, kept separate from low-position concentration

source_definition_paraphrase: A narrow range at a secondary low after the absolute low is auxiliary accumulation evidence.
exact_data_required: daily price path and relative position

source_definition_paraphrase: Bullish runs are longer and gradual while bearish legs are shorter, producing the book's saw-tooth accumulation description.
frozen_operationalization: 60-session mean positive-run length >=1.5x negative-run length at <=70% position

source_definition_paraphrase: A sharp pit is recovered and price then holds horizontally near the former pit edge.
exact_data_required: daily drawdown, recovery, and recent range
frozen_operationalization: >=10% pit, recovery to within 5% of edge, final 10-session range <=10%

source_definition_paraphrase: Trading in the valley between two chip peaks progressively fills the valley and may describe absorption of trapped inventory.
exact_data_required: two full-distribution modes and their history
frozen_operationalization: two tracked modes >=10% apart with price in the valley; no claim of investor identity

source_definition_paraphrase: A large lower retained peak and upper trapped peak form a valley; the lower peak may anchor wounded-control or support inference.
exact_data_required: full distribution modes, lower retention, drawdown path
frozen_operationalization: lower mass >=15%, upper >=10%, gap >=10%, with separate retained/distributed lower-base states

source_definition_paraphrase: Previously high inferred control suffers a rapid decline before full distribution and trades near the inferred cost/base, creating a possible self-rescue incentive.
exact_data_required: prior control proxy, markup, retention, drawdown, inferred cost
frozen_operationalization: prior control >=50%, markup >=30%, 20-session drawdown <=-20%, retention >=80%, within 15% of inferred cost

source_method: 成本低位锁定 while price rises
source_definition_paraphrase: The cost distribution stays low while market price rises, implying price/cost divergence without observed investor identity.
frozen_operationalization: checkpoint-to-checkpoint fixed-zone retention plus prior price return

source_method: low-cost inventory retention after substantial profit
source_definition_paraphrase: A large low-cost body has modeled floating profit of 10/20/25/30/40%+ yet survives with age and retention.
exact_data_required: full lot distribution, holding-day cells, price, turnover history
frozen_operationalization: all five predetermined profit distances; turnover-since-profit is separately marked approximate

source_definition_paraphrase: Loss of low-cost mass and upward relocation after appreciation is distribution evidence.
exact_data_required: adjacent full distributions; corporate-action transforms; prior markup
frozen_operationalization: previous 20%-profit zone retention: intact >=80%, migrating 50%-80%, largely distributed <50%; no clipping
